content: MongoDB Atlas Administration API uses HTTP Digest Authentication with an org-level Public/Private API key pair (legacy method; MongoDB now recommends service accounts/OAuth2 client-credentials instead). No official Python SDK package is required — it's a plain REST API; httpx does not natively support digest auth so a manual digest-auth implementation or the 'httpx-auth' add-on package would be needed. Reference impl: github.com/mongodb-developer/atlas-admin-api-digest-auth.
